_comment_metadata_column: Shape of dataset_versions.metadata for a DELTA version (v2-v9, v11-v19, ...). No top-level 'metadata' key — it is omitted because the full GWDM is reconstructed by applying 'patch' to the nearest snapshot.
_comment_patch_column: The dataset_versions.patch column holds the RFC 6902 JSON Patch array shown below. It is stored in its own column, not inside the metadata envelope.
_reconstruction: To read full GWDM: find nearest snapshot at or below this version, then apply each delta patch in order. See DatasetService::getReconstructedMetadataEnvelope().
